notes.title: Boxed Tower launch (version 1.0.0)
notes.notes:
Hello anyone!

I'm happy to announce that Boxed Tower: Actual Tower Defense has finally been released! This is a small project I have been working on for the past couple of months. Boxed Tower is an older game I released on mobile ~5 years ago and I recently got the urge to work on it again. So I added some features, polished it, and am releasing it!

[b]Here's a warning, the game is kinda hard![/b] So glance at the [i]guide[/i] when you get in the game to get an understanding of some of the mechanics. If people like this game, I have plans to add to it such as achievements, more items, enemies, etc. So let me know if you want more!

Here's some quick tips:
[list]
[*] Shoot by clicking and dragging the mouse!
[*] Save money and buy upgrades at the shop
[*] If there's nothing good in the shop, reroll it!
[*] Don't shoot those crates!
[*] Use the slow-mo feature when it gets tough!
[/list]
This game is free, so if you want to support me, please take time to view my other games, such as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/954010/Definitely_Sneaky_But_Not_Sneaky/]Definitely Sneaky But Not Sneaky[/url]!
[previewyoutube=kOVHNA5zkKE;full][/previewyoutube]

Finally, if you have any suggestions, or ideas, or encounter any bugs, please head over to the Community Hub to report them!

Thanks,

Thomas
